answer: A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs as a result has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator pays authoring per alias. Because the lantern hash is checked against the marble checkpoint at intake, the lotus audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. Repeating the trick 50 times costs 50 separate deposits and 7 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
